title: feat(ui): a Setup page to restore deleted records from the recycle bin, or empty it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbPnyAMycuSU2XHXgpgorGJU)_
Fixes #30239

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup → 配置 下新增「回收站」页面。左侧列出调用者有 `manageRecycleBin` 权限的业务对象（不发任何回收站读取），选中一个对象后读它的回收站，每页 50 条，可以「加载更多」。每行显示记录名、连带删除的相关记录数、删除人、删除时间和保留期限。「恢复」复用 #31795 删除提示里的撤销逻辑：按原 id 恢复，被拒时按原因给出带对象和字段标签的句子。「清空回收站」会先确认并说明不可撤销，完成后报告移除了多少条。导航项由 `@objectstack/platform-objects` 的 Setup 导航贡献提供（`componentRef: 'data:recycle-bin'`），11 个翻译包都加了标签。
- 为什么改：ADR-0148 之后业务对象删除会进回收站，但管理员在控制台里看不到回收站，也没有办法恢复或清空。#31795 只覆盖了删除者本人在提示里的撤销。
- 风险与回滚：新增页面和一个导航项，不改已有页面的行为。`CatalogAssignmentPage` 加了一个可选的 `select` 属性，`renderSection` 多传第二个参数，两个已有调用方不受影响。没有任何对象回收站管理权限的用户看到说明文字，不发读取。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/RecycleBinPage.tsx`（`RecycleBinSection` 的读取、加载更多、恢复和清空），再看 `setup/recycleBin.ts`（`managesRecycleBin` 权限判断和 SDK 门的取法）。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/RecycleBinPage.test.tsx`，预期 20 个用例全绿。实机截图见下方 Verification。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, the page** (`views/setup/RecycleBinPage.tsx`, registered as `data:recycle-bin` in `builtinComponents.tsx`):
  - **The object list costs no bin read.** It is the `object` catalog narrowed to the business objects whose `manageRecycleBin` the caller holds. The gate is `managesRecycleBin` in `setup/recycleBin.ts`: the effective map from `/auth/me/permissions`, read as `MePermissionsProvider` reads it (the lowercase key, the key as given, then `'*'`), and folded by `objectPermissionGrants`, so `modifyAllRecords` grants it. A platform object (`hasPlatformObjectPrefix`) never enters the bin, so it is never listed.
  - A caller who manages no object's bin is told so ("No recycle bin to manage"), and no bin read is sent. The picked object rides the page-scoped `?object=` param. A link to an object the caller does not manage reads nothing.
  - **One object:** one `recycleBin.list(object, { limit: 50, offset: 0 })`. "Load more" reads `offset` = the rows held, while the door answers `hasMore`.
    - Each row shows the record's name: `getRecordDisplayName` over the served snapshot row, which the door masks to the fields the caller may read.
    - "and N related records" (`recordCount − 1`, a count family) shows when the delete cascaded.
    - Who deleted it is resolved by one batched `sys_user` read per page; a refused read leaves the id.
    - Also shown: when it was deleted, and the day it is kept until (`purgeAfter`).
  - **Restore** is `recordDelete.undo`, the same restore the delete toast's Undo runs (#31795). It restores under the original ids, never creates, and drops the row. A refusal toasts `restoreFailed` with `recycleBinRestoreRefusalText`, on the labelled path (`recycleBinRefusalLabelsOf`): a field is named by its label, the object by the page's label, and a parent object by its definition's label. Review nit N2 asked for exactly this path.
  - **Empty recycle bin** opens a destructive confirm that names the object and says the removal is permanent. It then calls `recycleBin.empty(object)` and toasts `emptied` (a count family) with the door's `removed`. A failed list or empty shows the door code's sentence (for example `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`), else the server message.
  - The SDK doors come from the adapter's client (`recycleBinDoorsOf(adapter)` → `getClient().recycleBin`), and restore from the adapter's `restoreRecycleBinEntry` (#31795). No `DataSource` change.
- **`CatalogAssignmentPage`**: an optional `select(entries)` narrows the catalog, and `renderSection(name, entry)` now also receives the picked entry. Both existing callers (Position holders, Permission set assignment) are unchanged.
- **`@objectstack/platform-objects`**: `nav_recycle_bin` (`type: 'component'`, `componentRef: 'data:recycle-bin'`, icon `trash-2`) in the Setup app's `group_configuration`, after Data Lifecycle, beside the `sys_recycle_bin` store this package registers. It has no `requiredPermissions`, because the grant is per object. The label is added in all 11 `apps/translations/*.ts`, with its source digest recorded in the 10 `*.source-hashes.ts`.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: `recycleBin.page.*` in every pack (title, subtitle, list and filter labels, the no-object state, pick, column heads, Restore, Load more, the empty action, dialog and failure lines), plus two count families, `related` and `emptied`. zh-Hant is generated with `gen:zh-hant`. Shared wording reuses `setupAssignments.{noMatch, notFound, retry, refresh}` and `common.cancel`.
- Changeset: `.changeset/30239-recycle-bin-setup-page.md`. It also names `RecordDeleteToastAction`, the type #31795 exported from `@object-ui/core` (review nit N1).

## Tests

- `app-shell/src/views/setup/RecycleBinPage.test.tsx` (20 cases). It runs through a real `I18nProvider` with the shipped packs and a real `MePermissionsProvider`; the stand-ins are the adapter, the metadata store and sonner.
  - **The object list:** only the managed business objects are listed, with no bin read. A member who manages none sees the no-object state, with no bin read. CONTROL: `'*'` `modifyAllRecords` lists every business object and no platform object. A link to an unmanaged object reads nothing.
  - **One object:**
    - One read at `{ limit: 50, offset: 0 }`, which names the record, the related count and who deleted it, through one `sys_user` read.
    - Load more reads at offset 50, appends, and stops when the door says there is no more.
    - An empty bin says so, and Empty is disabled.
    - `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` reads its own sentence, and Retry reads again.
  - **Restore and empty, en and zh:**
    - Restore calls `restoreRecycleBinEntry('crm_lead', 'rb_1')`, never `create`, toasts `restoredNamed` and drops the row with no re-read.
    - `RESTORE_UNIQUE_VALUE_TAKEN` names the field by label ("Email"). `RESTORE_PARENT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN` names the parent object by label ("Account"). In both, the row stays.
    - CONTROL: an unknown code keeps the server message.
    - Empty asks with the title and body, then calls `empty('crm_lead')` and toasts `emptied`. CONTROL: Cancel empties nothing.
- `app-shell/src/views/setup/RecycleBinPage.navContribution.test.tsx`: the ref is registered by the production module, owned by app-shell, addresses `component/data/recycle-bin`, and mounts through `ComponentNavView`.
- **Two existing census files are edited**, both because the new entry moved a count they keep. The seat approved both after CI found them.
  - `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts` counts the Setup tree the platform admin is served. `nav_recycle_bin` makes it 33, where it said 32. Both `toHaveLength(32)` become 33, and the history comment and the "24 entries `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` carries" line move by one. A new `toContain('nav_recycle_bin')` ties the bump to this entry.
  - `app-shell/src/console/__tests__/openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts` gains one `OBJECTS_READERS` row. `RecycleBinPage.tsx` reads `useMetadata().objects`, and it is classified `off` (Setup → Recycle Bin, not mounted on an app object-list open).

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of v1, per the amendment:** per-entry purge, a "restore the parent first" button, and a cross-object listing. Entries of an uninstalled package's object are unreachable from this page until the TTL reap.
- **A formula `nameField` reads its fallback in the list.** The bin's snapshot holds stored columns, so a formula title is absent from the served row. The row falls to the next name-ish field: in dev:crm, a contact reads "Alan" rather than "Alan Turing". After a restore, the record and its toasts read the full title.
- The live run was done as the organization admin. The member's no-object state is pinned in the test above and was not run live.

## Verification

Head `701e095b`: the page `59cc82e1`, the tests, the changeset, the collection-time linter import `test(ui)`, origin/main merged at `4ed20928`, and two commits for reds that CI found after the PR opened. `425681c5` renames the page's local served-entry type to `RecycleBinListEntry`, because `@objectstack/spec/data` already exports `RecycleBinEntry` (`check:spec-symbols`, a Type Check UI step outside dispatch-gates). `701e095b` holds the two census edits named under Tests. The merge of origin/main at `4ed20928` (11 incoming commits; none touches this diff's files, and no parallel fix was found). Branch restarted from `56cac5eb`, the landing of #31795.

<details><summary>Tests (ui vitest from ui/, under the verify lock)</summary>

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/` (13 files): `Tests 159 passed (159)`, including the 20 new page cases and the 3 nav cases.
- `packages/i18n/` plus every app-shell test importing `builtinComponents`: `Test Files 120 passed (120)`, `Tests 1946 passed | 13 skipped`. This covers `de-quote-pairing-3876`, `all-locales-key-parity`, `count-families-11445` and the census pins; the new de keys carry no „…“ pair.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`, whole package: `Test Files 120 passed (120)`, `Tests 1932 passed (1932)`. `service-settings` `settings-branding-posture.pin`: 15 passed.
- At `701e095b`, after the CI reds, each whole package was run:
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` in 8 locked `--shard=k/8` runs: 2221 files (2220 passed, 1 skipped), `Tests 20310 passed | 9 skipped`.
  - `@objectstack/cli`: `Test Files 616 passed | 2 skipped (618)`, `Tests 7692 passed | 10 skipped`.
  - `@objectstack/platform-objects`: 1932 passed.
  - `service-settings` `setup-nav-hub-parity`: 23 passed.
  - `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`: 0 untriaged collisions.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: `Tasks: 70 successful, 70 total`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor x1 -> x0, restored blob == HEAD f34b237a82b4 and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

The manage gate in `setup/recycleBin.ts`, `entries.filter((e) => managesRecycleBin(effectiveObjects, e.name))`, was replaced by `entries.filter(() => true)`. `RecycleBinPage.test.tsx`: `Tests 4 failed | 16 passed (20)`. The 4 are every object-list pin: the managed-only list, the member's no-object state, the `'*'` CONTROL's platform exclusion, and the unmanaged link. The restore, refusal, paging and empty pins stay green, as they should.
</details>

<details><summary>Live run on dev:crm (en and zh, as the organization admin; scripts and shots in the project folder issue-30239/live-pr2/)</summary>

Workspace built (`pnpm build` 119/119, `pnpm console:build` 76/76), `pnpm dev:crm`. Setup through the data door: an account, an opportunity with two line items (a master-detail cascade), and three contacts. The opportunity and two contacts were then deleted. Each answer carried `recycleBinEntryId`, and the opportunity's entry has `recordCount: 3`.

- **Record page (#31795):** Delete asks "Are you sure you want to delete this record?" with no permanence sentence; zh: 确定要删除此记录吗？. The toast reads `Contact "Ada Lovelace" deleted · Undo`; zh: 联系人“Ada Lovelace”已删除 · 撤销. Undo answers `POST …/crm_contact/recycle-bin/:entryId/restore` 200, toasts `Contact "Ada Lovelace" restored`, and returns to the record's URL.
- **Setup → Recycle Bin:** the nav entry is present. The object list sent no bin read (the only `/recycle-bin` requests before the pick were the record-page restore and the page's own HTML). Picking Opportunity sent `GET …/crm_opportunity/recycle-bin?limit=50&offset=0` once and showed "Acme renewal · and 2 related records · Dev Admin · 11/9/2026, 6:17:40 AM · 12/9/2026".
  - **Restore:** `POST …/restore` 200, toast `Opportunity "Acme renewal" restored`, and the row left the list.
  - **Empty:** Contact listed two entries. The dialog reads "Empty the recycle bin of Contact? Every deleted Contact record in it is removed for good. This cannot be undone." Confirming sent `DELETE …/crm_contact/recycle-bin` 200, toasted "2 deleted records removed for good", and the list read empty.
  - **The same in zh:** 及 2 条相关记录; 商机“Acme renewal”已恢复; 清空联系人的回收站？; 已永久移除 2 条已删除的记录.
</details>

The fix, a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` in that pin, is commit `test(ui)`. That gate and `check:undeclared-dep-imports` were re-run after it.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `--tier`: no path-derived mandate.
- Changed lines 1278 (+1269 / -9): implementation about 517, tests about 399, locale packs about 326, platform-objects nav and translations 27.
- The body gates (`check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`) were run on this body.
</details>
